author: श्रीराघवेन्द्रस्वामी
commentary: तद्वचनमाह ॥ स्थान इत्यादिना । हे हृषीकेश सर्वेन्द्रियप्रेरक तव प्रकीर्त्या जगत्प्रहृष्यति अनुरज्यते चेत्यादि (कं) स्थाने । अव्ययमेतत् । युक्तमेवेत्यर्थः ॥ ११.३६॥
translation:
Arjuna said. It is just, O Hrishikésa, that with Thy great glory the world is delighted and becomes devoted (to Thee); the evil spirits being afraid run in all directions and the throngs of Siddhas are all worshipping Thee. (36)
V. Hrishikésa: the ruler of all the senses.
